column4: Min-Gan transitional variety (Shao-Jiang), classified as Min by many dialectologists; filed under Gan by Glottolog. Its basic vocabulary sets Gan's (and Chinese-without-Min's) deepest split on its own (lone_branches.py). Kept in Sinitic.
Misfiled: 0.60 from every other Yue list (which agree with each other, median 0.38) and 0.49 from Mandarin; a Guilin-area Sinitic variety, so kept in Sinitic (lone_branches.py).
Misfiled: 0.27 from Lingui Pinghua, no closer than 0.49 to any Yue list; a Guilin-area Sinitic variety, kept in Sinitic (lone_branches.py, misplaced.py).
Likely a local Pinghua/tuhua variety (nga 'I', lhui 'water'): its nearest Sinitic lists are all Pinghua (0.58) and it is 0.70 from the median Mandarin list; kept in Sinitic (misplaced.py).

Standard-Mandarin-like data under an Eastern Min label (wo 'I', nimen, women, xie 'blood', gutou 'bone'); 0.30 from Mandarin lists, 0.53 from Min. Sinitic either way, so kept in Sinitic (misplaced.py).
